source.title: [M9.9][HOLD] Independent security review, M6 provenance and CODEOWNERS governance
source.body:
## Purpose — non-release tracking issue

Coordinates **M9.9** for [draft PR #38](https://github.com/Permaculture-DAO/prometheus-runtime/pull/38) (head `0d8b2dcdfd17310a3e9465ed8161c0acf5c80672`) and [draft PR #37](https://github.com/Permaculture-DAO/prometheus-runtime/pull/37) (head `0778ba2a1bf91366777d4d7911fa8dafee784f25`). No automatic merge, codeowner-rule bypass, Holochain update, Canon promotion, real MRV or VPS production deployment is authorized.

**Known evidence:** PR #38 has three successful CI workflows tied to its signed head; the two PRs have **no formal human reviews** as of the milestone. Its M6 ancestor remains **GitHub `unsigned`**.

### 1. Qualified independent review — HOLD
- [ ] Identify a **human reviewer** with security/cryptography/distributed-systems experience, **different from the PR author/source custodian**, with repository access and declared conflicts of interest.
- [ ] Have reviewer assess trust-boundary/provenance, host identity, key rotation and revocation, fail-closed behavior, audit storage, cross-process/cross-host replay and crash recovery, build provenance and dependency risks.
- [ ] Reviewer records findings and GO/HOLD **against the exact head SHA** (and re-reviews after changes). Local automated audit and passing CI do not count as independent approval.

### 2. Review-path governance for `main` — HOLD
The active main ruleset requires **at least one approving review AND codeowner review**, and the current `.github/CODEOWNERS` assigns `* @Uwohali`; PR #37 is authored by `@Uwohali`. GitHub does not allow PR authors to approve their own PRs. **No ruleset bypass is acceptable as remediation.**
- [ ] Authorize a separate, reviewed, signed governance PR (originated by an **independent qualified integrator** and approved by the existing code owner) that adds a suitable independent code owner/team with verified repository permissions; OR present another rules-compliant independently reviewed path.
- [ ] Ensure independent reviewer approval and code-owner approval are both actually fulfilled; do not pretend a comment or check run equals review.

### 3. Original M6 unsigned commit — source-custodian decision required
- [ ] Record **one** source-custodian-approved option in a signed ADR:
  - **A. Preserve original SHA** and produce a signed M6 source/tree/provenance attestation with a documented and explicitly accepted exception to the internal all-signed-commits policy. **This does not make the M6 GitHub commit VERIFIED.**
  - **B. Create a separately reviewed new fully signed history** with new commit SHAs, fresh CI and approvals, without secretly rewriting published PR history.
- [ ] Verify any release workflow, signer and independent review evidence satisfy the chosen policy.

### 4. Staging prerequisites — HOLD
- [ ] Identify a **separate named VPS staging host** and obtain approval for staging-only access.
- [ ] Provide host-based IAM/KMS and certificate-to-actor binding, authorization and revocation, transactionally shared replay protection across hosts, external/WORM audit, kill switch and OS-level isolation.
- [ ] Capture rollback/restore, logs, capacity/latency and real staging safety gates. **Synthetic local two-worker tests are not VPS/multi-host proof.**

### 5. Separation of authorities — HOLD
- [ ] Final releases, GitHub merge, Canon, Holochain identity/DNA and production each need their own explicitly signed and approved decision, with no conflation between PROMETHEUS and Tribeke governance.

**Milestone status:** GO for sourcing reviewers and governance decisions; **HOLD** for merge, staging deployment, Holochain and production. This issue itself is neither review approval nor release authorization.

comments.text:
### M9.10 — Independent reviewer onboarding (OPEN / no reviewer appointed)

The repository's current eligible human collaborator inventory contains **only `@Uwohali`** (the PR author); no repository teams are listed. Neither PR #37 nor PR #38 has a formal independent human review. This is a **request for qualified candidates**, **not** an assignment, security approval, invitation to access infrastructure, offer of compensation, or authorization to change release policy.

**Scope:** Independent threat-model/code review of [PR #38](https://github.com/Permaculture-DAO/prometheus-runtime/pull/38) at signed head `0d8b2dcdfd17310a3e9465ed8161c0acf5c80672`, inherited unsigned M6 base `0778ba2a1bf91366777d4d7911fa8dafee784f25`, and documented evidence (3 CI checks PASS). Review includes Python/FastAPI trust boundary, Ed25519 provenance, bearer/mTLS identity binding, replay state across replicas, audit/integrity, crash safety, and default-off noncanonical permissions.

**Candidate onboarding evidence requested (do not post private contact details or credentials):**
1. Public GitHub handle and relevant public examples of security/crypto/distributed-system review experience.
2. Disclosure of any affiliation with PR authors, PROMETHEUS, Permaculture DAO, code vendors or other material conflicts of interest; disclose privately if sensitive.
3. Statement of availability, boundaries, expected deliverables, and whether an independently appointed maintainer can provision scoped GitHub permissions.
4. Signed/recorded independent review of the *exact reviewed SHA*, with reproducible findings, severity and an explicit HOLD/GO recommendation. CI checks and AI analysis are not substitutes.
5. If considered as a code owner, **explicit repository `write` permission** and a separate rules-compliant, independently authored CODEOWNERS governance PR are prerequisites.

**GitHub governance constraint:** Current `main` ruleset requires 1 approval + CODEOWNER approval. `.github/CODEOWNERS` currently assigns `* @Uwohali`, the author. No admin bypass and no self-review. A future independent integrator must submit the CODEOWNERS change as a separately reviewed PR, with an appropriate existing code-owner approval, before the author-owned PRs can satisfy the intended independent code-owner gate.

**M6 provenance decision remains pending:** proposed Option A = preserve SHA with custodian-signed attestation and *explicit permitted exception*; Option B = new signed history, SHA changes, fresh CI/review. Neither option has been selected, signed or implemented. GitHub's currently observed main ruleset did not list a required-signatures rule; that does **not** establish permission under PROMETHEUS's internal custody/release policy.

**Security HOLDs prior to any authorized staging or release:** real cert-to-actor binding, distributed replay semantics, IAM/KMS/revocation, independent append-only audit, recovery/performance, external review, and named separate staging environment. No merge, Holochain/Canon action, or production deployment permitted.

**Next responsible action:** source custodian screens candidate(s), documents selection/COI and authorizes a scoped review invitation. This comment makes no selection on their behalf.

## M9.11 — External reviewer prequalification **sourcing only**; ADR remains HOLD (19 Nov 2026)

**State:** NO vendor or individual engaged, NO inquiry sent, NO fees committed, NO GitHub access granted, NO review/COI approved, NO custodian ADR selection/signature.

### Publicly evidenced candidate organizations (not endorsed or appointed)
1. **Least Authority** — previously published security audits of **Holochain Deterministic Integrity** and **Lair Keystore**; https://leastauthority.com/blog/audit-of-holochain-deterministic-integrity-crate/ and https://leastauthority.com/blog/audit-of-holochain-lair-keystore/ . Official RFI: https://leastauthority.com/security-consulting/request-a-proposal/ . **COI assessment mandatory**, including prior Holochain supplier/client work.
2. **Trail of Bits** — independent software/security assurance and cryptography review services; https://trailofbits.com/services/software-assurance/ . Official inquiry: https://trailofbits.com/contact/ . Direct Holochain-specific capacity, cost and actual reviewer availability **not verified**.
3. **OtterSec** — security audits and backend work including Python and Rust; https://osec.io/services/ and https://osec.io/audits/ . Official inquiry: https://osec.io/contact/ . Holochain specialization, independence and reviewer availability **not verified**.

A **read-only RFI draft**, objective COI criteria, and a machine-checkable **UNDECIDED** M6 provenance ADR decision template have been prepared offline. **8/8 local structural validation tests PASS**; the blank ADR correctly returns **HOLD**. These tests do not validate the legal authority of any signer or evidence of independent review.

### Human decision and governance gates
- Source custodian chooses which organization(s) may receive a **nonbinding** prequalification inquiry or nominates a qualified independent individual; approves any fees and access separately.
- A named human reviewer declares relevant conflicts and submits reproducible findings tied to PR #38 exact SHA `0d8b2dcdfd17310a3e9465ed8161c0acf5c80672`.
- Source custodian identifies the authoritative signing policy and selects **Option A** (retain unsigned M6 SHA + signed attestation **only if a policy-authorized exception exists**) or **Option B** (separate fully signed reconstructed history and fresh CI/reviews). **No selection has been made**.
- Main CODEOWNERS currently `* @Uwohali` (PR author). Independent integrator + compliant governance PR and appropriate repository permissions must precede the original PRs' intended independent CODEOWNER gate.
- The M9.9 findings on cross-host replay and mTLS cert-to-actor binding remain **HOLD**; other operational/security gates continue unchanged.

**Decision:** GO for candidate prequalification planning, **HOLD** for sending any binding RFP, auditor appointment, ADR approval, merge, staging VPS, Holochain, real-world MRV, token/capital authority and production.

Detailed evidence/decision dossier is packaged off-GitHub as `PROMETHEUS_OMEGA_M911_REVIEWER_ENGAGEMENT_ADR_HANDOFF_v0_911_2026-11-19.zip`. This comment creates **no appointment, signature or release authority**.

## M9.12 — Reviewer prequalification draft & M6 provenance decision gate (HOLD)

**Current read-only baseline (2026-11-19):** PR #37 = draft, unsigned M6 head `0778ba2a1bf91366777d4d7911fa8dafee784f25`, no human reviews; PR #38 = draft, signed head `0d8b2dcdfd17310a3e9465ed8161c0acf5c80672`, three CI workflows SUCCESS, no human reviews.

**Concrete action:** An unsent **Gmail draft** for a *nonbinding public-source-only* reviewer prequalification inquiry was created for Least Authority via their published consulting contact. It requests a named reviewer/COI declaration, scope, public precedents, tentative timing and budget range. No email was sent, no contract or expenditure authorized and no credentials or private documents shared. Trail of Bits and OtterSec remain alternative organizational candidates; no individual selected.

**Decision packet:** M6 Option A (source history preserved; independent attestation **only with verified policy permission for a specific exception**) and Option B (new fully signed history, mapping and fresh CI/reviews) are both documented. **Neither has been authorized or signed.** The currently available M9.11 source does not establish an authoritative signing exception clause. This means no retrospective claim that the unsigned M6 commit is verified.

**Structural gate tests:** 12/12 PASS; the unfilled ADR template returns **HOLD** as intended, and forged signature or unauthorized deployment fields fail validation. These checks do not constitute human legal authority or cryptographic attestation.

**Further governance gates:** no independently appointed reviewer and no independent current CODEOWNER; any CODEOWNERS change requires a compliant separate PR. Previously demonstrated gaps in cross-host replay, mTLS certificate-to-actor binding, external audit and separate authorized staging persist.

**Decision:** GO for custodian examination of the **unsent inquiry draft** and for competent human selection of a reviewer/ADR option; **HOLD** for external engagement without approval, ADR execution, merge, Holochain, claims/capital authority, VPS staging and production.

**Offline handoff:** `PROMETHEUS_OMEGA_M912_REVIEWER_SELECTION_ADR_HANDOFF_v0_912_2026-11-19.zip` (12 files, 11 checksums verified). Repository code and branch state unchanged.
